label: Context

child_texts: Use prior knowledge, formal or informal research, and discussions with others to identify the key components of context that are most relevant. (I/C)

competency_statement: Use knowledge of important context elements like background information, location, culture, time period, and current events to understand and create texts.
observable_behaviors: Identify key context components such as background information, geographic location, cultural influences, time period, and contemporary events when reading or discussing texts.
